test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Sarvana failed in the examination last week and is __in extreme depression__ these days.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "In the doldrums".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"In the doldrums"** refers to a state of inactivity, stagnation, or depression. (उदासी/निराशा की स्थिति)

 
 
• **Example:** After losing his job, he has been in the doldrums for weeks.
 
 
 
• The phrase **"In the lurch"** means to leave someone in a difficult situation without help or support. (मुसीबत में अकेला छोड़ देना)
 
 
• **Example:** She felt abandoned when her friends left her in the lurch during the project presentation.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct idiom for the given sentence is **"In the doldrums"**, as it best describes Sarvana's state of depression. (उदासी की स्थिति)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **In the red** (घाटे में): Refers to a financial loss or debt.

 
 
• **Example:** The company was in the red after a poor quarter of sales.
 
 
 
• **In cold blood** (निर्दयता से): Refers to doing something, especially a crime, in a deliberate and unemotional manner.
 
 
• **Example:** The murder was committed in cold blood, shocking the entire community.
 
 
 
• **In the lurch** (मुसीबत में अकेला छोड़ देना): Refers to abandoning someone in a difficult situation.
 
 
• **Example:** He felt betrayed when his friends left him in the lurch during the crisis..
